friendly_name.label: Display Name
friendly_name.description: Name shown in Live Inputs and on players.

include_monitors.label: Include monitor sources
include_monitors.description: Also show sink monitor sources in the input picker.

auto_trigger.label: Auto-start on signal
auto_trigger.description: Line-sense mode: automatically start playback when input signal is detected and stop after silence.

target_player_id.label: Auto-start target player
target_player_id.description: Player to start when signal is detected.

trigger_threshold_dbfs.label: Signal threshold (dBFS)
trigger_threshold_dbfs.description: RMS level above which the input is considered active.

enable_cast_metadata.label: Mirror now-playing from a Chromecast
enable_cast_metadata.description: Read-only: watches a Chromecast on the network and shows its title/artist/album as this source's stream metadata.

chromecast_host.label: Chromecast host
chromecast_host.description: IP address or hostname of the Chromecast to mirror now-playing info from.

icon_preset.label: Icon
icon_preset.description: Icon shown for this source in Live Inputs and on players.

thumbnail_image.label: Custom icon URL
thumbnail_image.description: URL to a custom image, used when Icon is set to Custom.

monitors.title: Local Audio Source
monitors.description: Choose whether monitor sources should also be listed.

device.title: Select Audio Input
device.description: Pick the PulseAudio/PipeWire source to capture.

errors.no_packets: No audio could be captured from source {0} for '{1}'.
